tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Capitol Police may accept the donation of animals to be used in the canine units of the Capitol Police.

tree.heading: Effective date
tree.text: This section shall apply with respect to fiscal year 2005 and each fiscal year thereafter.

notes.text: Codification Section is from the Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2005, which is div. G of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2005.
